name: acai
description: Acai: self-hosted compliance audit agent, MCP server, dashboard and IDE extension.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @acai/dashboard && npm run typecheck -w acai-vscode

scripts.check: npm run registry:validate && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run eval:detectors && npm run build
